Shape the Future of Manufacturing with SolidCAM

Join a global team that’s redefining innovation in CNC machining and manufacturing technology. At SolidCAM, your ideas, expertise, and passion will help drive the next era of intelligent manufacturing.

Where Innovation Meets Precision

At SolidCAM, we’re more than just a CAM software company we’re a team of thinkers, makers, and doers who believe in transforming the way the world manufactures.

With cutting-edge solutions integrated seamlessly with SOLIDWORKS and Autodesk Inventor, our technology empowers industries across the globe — and it all starts with our people.

Whether you’re an engineer, developer, marketer, or support professional, you’ll find an environment that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

View Open Positions

Our Culture

Empowering People. Enabling Excellence.

At SolidCAM, our culture is built around a shared vision to empower every individual to excel, innovate, and make a meaningful impact in the world of manufacturing technology.

We believe that true innovation comes from people who are inspired, trusted, and supported to perform at their best. Here’s what defines life at SolidCAM:

Global Impact

Be part of a truly international organization with teams and customers across the world.
At SolidCAM, you’ll collaborate with experts from diverse industries — from aerospace and automotive to medical and precision engineering.

Your work will directly contribute to advancing CNC machining processes and driving digital manufacturing transformation on a global scale.

Continuous Innovation

Innovation is in our DNA. We constantly push boundaries to develop smarter, faster, and more efficient solutions for the manufacturing world.

As part of our team, you’ll have the freedom to explore ideas, experiment with the latest technologies, and contribute to projects that shape the future of Industry 4.0. We encourage creativity, curiosity, and the courage to challenge convention.

Collaborative Spirit

We grow together. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do — whether it’s solving technical challenges, improving user experiences, or delivering exceptional customer support.

At SolidCAM, you’ll find a culture of open communication, respect, and teamwork, where every voice matters and every contribution counts.

Career Development

Your growth is our priority.

We invest in our people through continuous learning programs, mentorship from industry experts, and opportunities to work on global projects.

From skill-building workshops to cross-functional collaboration, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to expand your expertise and take your career to the next level.

Balance & Wellbeing

We understand that great work starts with a healthy mind and body.

That’s why we promote a balanced work environment that values flexibility, inclusivity, and overall wellbeing.

Whether through flexible work arrangements, supportive leadership, or a positive team culture, we ensure that our employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

Let’s Build the Future Together

If you’re ready to join a company that values innovation, precision, and people SolidCAM is the place for you. Together, we’ll shape the future of manufacturing technology.

Know more
Stay connected. Join our Newsletter.

The Ecosystem for Digital Manufacturing

SolidCAM offers seamless, single-window CAM software integration with leading CAD platforms: SOLIDWORKS®, Solid Edge®, and Autodesk Inventor®. All machining operations can be defined, calculated, and verified directly inside your familiar CAD environment, eliminating time-consuming and error-prone file transfers. This streamlined approach ensures a faster, more efficient, and highly reliable workflow.
